name: Premier Exports International
tagline: Premium frozen seafood from India's west coast
description: Premier Exports International is an EU- and Japan-approved, HACCP and BRCGS (A Grade) certified seafood processor and exporter based in Chandiroor, Kerala, India. Founded in 1982 and run today by the second generation, we export premium frozen shrimp, cuttlefish, squid, tuna and other marine products to Japan, Europe and the Middle East.
